novelty_flags.label: thm:thickness-entropy-separation
novelty_flags.one_line: Add AntoniadisPenskySapatinas2014: its finite, well-separated polynomial/exponential density-zero analysis is a close noncausal global-risk comparator and must be distinguished from the proposed expected-sup, two-sided multiplicity result.

soundness_flags.label: target_estimand and all boundary-risk statements
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed conditional expectation at a boundary point is only version-defined; define tau_P as the unique pair of one-sided Lipschitz traces (and state that it is the observed-law functional) rather than E[Y(1)-Y(0)|X=x] at a null point.

soundness_flags.label: def:count-adaptive-bandwidth and thm:pervasive-adaptive-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The admissible-scale set can be empty on a finite sample, so the smallest minimizer and hence widehat tau_n are undefined on an event with positive probability; specify a measurable fallback.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:arbitrary-modulus-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Neither “geometrically realizable” nor “associated thin-site packing profile” defines a law class linking m, q_{t,P}, and J_P, so its minimax risk and consistency criterion have no quantified domain.

soundness_flags.label: ass:boundary-packing
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited CTY paper assumes a rectifiable curve and a population-Gram condition, not the stated two-sided h^{-1} Ahlfors packing bound; retag this stronger condition as novel or provide an appropriate source.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every boundary conditional expectation by an explicitly defined one-sided observed-regression trace, define the empty-count fallback, and make the arbitrary-modulus OEQ quantify over a named class P(m,J).
Retag or properly source ass:boundary-packing and separately audit whether the Gaiffas2005 citation supports the proposed uniform two-sided polynomial-mass condition.
Add Antoniadis, Pensky, and Sapatinas (2014) and state precisely why its finite-zero univariate L2 theory neither proves nor refutes the proposed expected-sup BATEC separation.

Give an explicit smooth-boundary two-sided density family realizing the isolated and pervasive subclasses, including the boundary traces and the h-separated lower-bound sites, before attempting the matched-rate proof.
